描述_EN: eight strips of damask sewn together, with a pattern of floral sprays and butterflies. panel of red silk damask, embroidered with coloured floss silks and silver thread. an egret is standing in the water behind, near the stems of a clump of lotus, on a stem of which a kingfisher is clinging. each strip is embroidered with shrubs of peony growing from open rockeries, near which a pair of mandarin ducks is swimming.
描述_ZN: 八条大马士革缝在一起，有花和蝴蝶的图案。 红色丝绸大马士革的面板，用彩色绒线丝和银线刺绣。 后面有一只白鹭站在水中，靠近一丛荷花的茎，荷花的茎上有一只翠鸟在依附着。 每条绣有从开放的假山上长出的牡丹灌木，附近有一对鸳鸯在游泳。
